contradicting_evidence: The 24h cross-section provides a downside tilt: only 25 of 100 constituents advance, while BTC and ETH are down approximately 1.97% and 1.81%.
The completed hourly candle provides an opposing stabilization signal: BTC and ETH rise approximately 0.089% and 0.065%, with taker-buy quote shares near 71% and 69%.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Choppy stabilization or a renewed weakness test are both credible. The small hourly rebound does not establish continuation, while backward-looking 24h losses alone do not establish the next 12h move. No reliable net-direction forecast survives the conflicting signals and issuance-time observation gap.
falsification_conditions: Repeated spot-supported advances, improving breadth and strengthening ETH/BTC would replace NO_EDGE with an upside case.
Persistent declines accompanied by weaker breadth, falling ETH/BTC and sustained selling pressure would replace NO_EDGE with a downside case.
missing_evidence: Fresh completed candles and spot participation through issuance and the forecast window.
Repeated breadth observations showing whether the hourly stabilization spreads beyond BTC and ETH.
Comparable microstructure observations over time rather than isolated trade and depth samples.
supporting_evidence: BTC rises with slightly declining hourly open interest, while ETH rises with increasing open interest; these different participation patterns do not confirm a common spot-led recovery.
ETH/BTC's hourly return is reported flat, offering no fresh relative-leadership confirmation.
A single narrow positive candle after broad 24h losses demonstrates stabilization, not a durable directional reversal.
